claims.text: The proposed intervention is to use TOR-TILD with machine-learning acceleration.
TOR-TILD with machine-learning acceleration can retain ab initio-level accuracy.
The proposed method represents all thermodynamic effects relevant to the transition.
The intervention will improve determination of the transition temperature relative to existing experimental and computational baselines.
The intervention will improve determination of fusion enthalpy relative to existing experimental and computational baselines.
The intervention will improve determination of fusion entropy relative to existing experimental and computational baselines.
The intervention will improve determination of volume change at the transition relative to existing experimental and computational baselines.
The intervention will improve determination of dense-fluid heat capacity relative to existing experimental and computational baselines.
The approach is applicable to high-entropy materials in high-temperature states.
The approach remains applicable across relevant compositions and temperatures.
Available data are insufficient for systematic screening.
The hypothesis can be tested by benchmarking the proposed method against DFT free-energy studies.
